summary.text: Terrence Davis is the Democratic nominee. A former state trooper in Tennessee and South Dakota who is pursuing a doctorate in law and policy, he says he trusts the state's tested, audited vote-counting machines and wants to strengthen ties with county auditors, add a fraud-investigation division and let 16-year-olds pre-register. Republican incumbent Monae Johnson endorsed him.

paragraphs.text: Degrees in criminal justice and public policy; now pursuing a doctorate in law and policy.
Served as a state trooper in Tennessee (Memphis district and the Governor's Executive Protection Unit) and, since 2021, in the Sioux Falls district of South Dakota.
Most recently worked at East River Legal Services, which provides free civil legal help.
